Name: JP's More Warp Points v2 (CJB Cheats Menu) (1.6)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center]﻿[/center][center]CJB Warp Points v2[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[size=5][b][i][color=#ffff00]Important:[/color] Some i18n translations in the mod have been neglected for a long time, and I don't know if the users who created them are even active anymore. For anyone who is interested, you can make and update translations and, [color=#00ff00]if possible, upload them yourself to Nexus instead of sending them to me to integrate them.[/color] Thank you![/i][/b][/size]

[color=#ffff00][b][i][u][size=6]Important Data:[/size]
[/u][/i][/b][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]There are several mods that, although included in this mod, have not yet been updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and therefore will not be available for use until they are updated. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]It is recommended to use '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]'﻿ to configure the mod more easily and to have a description of what each option does. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#00ff00]You can configure which warps will be displayed in the CJB menu.[/color] [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]You can activate or deactivate the Warps you want at any time.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#00ff00][i]Stardew Valley/Expanded, East Scarp and Ridgeside Village Warps[/i][/color] can be deactivated by sections. [color=#00ffff][b]The sections[/b][/color] contain the warps to each corner within the corresponding zone (e.g. the town, the forest). [b]For those who don't want so many warps and want to be able to go quickly from one end of the menu to the other. [/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Warp to the door of the house should work for any custom map. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod recognizes if you have the Grandpa's Farm, Frontier Farm or IF2 map and will correctly take you to the correct Grandpa's Shed location. [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]

[*][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Japanese:[/size][/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Japanese translation of the mod was made by user: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/63249666]Thukino[/url]. Arigato![/size][/color][/b]

[/size][/color][size=5]You are free to translate the mod;[color=#00ff00] [/color][color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission.[/b][/color]
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size][size=5]
